messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for billing-usage - token_count_delta anomaly (sev=P1). Pager: PD-67890. Symptoms: token-count > +18% vs baseline, ingestion->aggregator lag increasing. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-67890

sam: acked. I'm oncall for eng-sre. Jumping in. Who's oncall for billing pipeline? @jess?

jess: yes i'm here. seeing a spike in `token_ingest_raw` and `aggregated_tokens` mismatch. dashboard: https://grafana/ru/boards/metering (quick peek)

sam: reported impact to customers? finance?

maria: finance-bot, FYI — potential invoice delta. Notified billing-ops. We'll freeze invoice generation for the affected window until we confirm counts.

jess: preliminary: looks like the aggregator batch window is double-counting when KV cache TTL expires during heavy bursts. Some shards are reprocessing prefixes leading to duplicated token counts. Root cause hypothesis, still investigating.

sam: ok mitigation plan (short): 1) failover ingestion routing to fallback aggregator pool `metering-hotfix-2026` 2) pause invoice job 3) start backfill/cleanup to dedupe counts 4) keep PD open and escalate if not stable in 15m

ryan: tagging in from eng-runtime. I'll help with the hotfix swap and confirm no schema drift. Oncall note: escalate to platform lead if failover doesn't reduce delta in 15.

jess: running the failover now. command: ```bash
./ops/switch_metering.sh --target metering-hotfix-2026 --reason "token-delta P1" --force
```

sam: executed a manual traffic-shift (~80% to hotfix). monitoring now.

incident-bot: PD update: acknowledged by sam at 1782506792. Next escalation timer: 15m.

jess: metrics after shift: `token_count_delta` down from +18% -> +4% in 2m. Ingestion lag also decreasing. Looks promising.

maria: continuing invoice freeze. Finance will hold any bill runs with affected timestamps and prepare communication for impacted customers.

ryan: running a dedupe backfill job in dry-run to confirm size. command: ```bash
kubectl -n metering run backfill-dedupe --image=redwood/metering-backfill:sha-abc123 --restart=OnFailure -- /app/backfill --dry-run --start 2026-03-14T10:00Z
```

sam: good call on dry-run. Keep me posted on estimated runtime.

jess: dry-run shows ~12k suspect records across shards, estimated real run 18 mins. I'll kick full backfill once we confirm no perf impact on hotfix cluster.

incident-bot: escalation timer paused (manual ack by sam).

ryan: dev patch ready to avoid double-counting: PR #3456 (runtime: guard cache rehydrate + idempotency token). I'll roll to staging and then to hotfix pool if green.

jess: rolling PR to hotfix pool now. patch applied to 3 nodes. monitoring trace: duplicate-count spikes eliminated on patched nodes.

sam: patch looks good. Traffic back to normal distribution in last 10m. token delta within +/-1% now.

maria: finance: holding invoices for the 30m window starting 2026-03-14T10:07Z. Will coordinate with customer success on messaging.

jess: starting the full backfill now (non-dry). command: ```bash
kubectl -n metering run backfill-dedupe --image=redwood/metering-backfill:sha-abc123 --restart=OnFailure -- /app/backfill --start 2026-03-14T10:00Z --end 2026-03-14T10:30Z
```

sam: monitoring backfill. ETA ~22m per dry-run. If CPU climbs >85% we throttle.

incident-bot: PD note: status update added to PD incident.

ryan: quick note on root cause: aggregator batch window edge-case when KV cache TTL < aggregation window + requeue latency. When TTL expired mid-window, the shard reprocessed prefix and emitted counts again. Fix introduces idempotency tokens and extends TTL buffer.

jess: backfill completed successfully. Deduped ~11,800 tokens (0.06% of total in window). No customer-facing charge changes after adjustments; finance confirmed minor rounding corrections only.

maria: finance confirms invoice hold lifted for unaffected windows. For the frozen window, we applied manual adjustments and will NOT auto-bill. Customer comms draft: "We detected and corrected a metering discrepancy; no action required from you. See details..." (internal review in progress). :white_check_mark:

sam: closing PD incident once deployment propagation looks stable for 30m. Patch merged to main: runtime PR #3456. Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 11:00 PST. Owners: jess (incident lead), ryan (runtime fix), sam (oncall timeline).

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-67890 marked as resolved at 1782506845.

jess: thumbs up. I'll file the postmortem with timeline, root cause, and follow-ups (add e2e regression test for KV TTL window, add alert for token-delta anomaly with automated course-correct steps).

sam: thanks team. action items: - jess: postmortem + runbook updates - ryan: add unit/integration test + monitor dashboard tweak - maria: finalize customer comms and invoice audit log.

finance-bot: Noted. Will archive audit entries and prepare amortization note if needed.

sam: nice work, everyone. :tada:
